CustomField.description: Field to set assessment result for Final Letter Review Assessments
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( ISPICKVAL(Evaluation_Type__c,'Final Letter Review Assessment'), AND( OR(ISPICKVAL(Complaint_issues_identified_addressed__c, 'Met'),ISPICKVAL(Complaint_issues_identified_addressed__c, 'N/A')), OR(ISPICKVAL(Are_our_findings_well_supported__c, 'Met'),ISPICKVAL(Are_our_findings_well_supported__c, 'N/A')), OR(ISPICKVAL(Is_our_decision_clearly_explained__c, 'Met'),ISPICKVAL(Is_our_decision_clearly_explained__c, 'N/A')), OR(ISPICKVAL(Is_the_resolution_clear__c, 'Met'),ISPICKVAL(Is_the_resolution_clear__c, 'N/A')), OR(ISPICKVAL(AFCA_details_provided_in_the_letter__c, 'Met'),ISPICKVAL(AFCA_details_provided_in_the_letter__c, 'N/A')), OR(ISPICKVAL(Did_we_identify_vulnerability__c, 'Met'),ISPICKVAL(Did_we_identify_vulnerability__c, 'N/A')), OR(ISPICKVAL(Were_care_and_access_needs_addressed__c, 'Met'),ISPICKVAL(Were_care_and_access_needs_addressed__c, 'N/A')), OR(ISPICKVAL(Did_we_respond_swiftly_to_hardship__c, 'Met'),ISPICKVAL(Did_we_respond_swiftly_to_hardship__c, 'N/A')), OR(ISPICKVAL(Did_we_meet_time_frames__c, 'Met'),ISPICKVAL(Did_we_meet_time_frames__c, 'N/A')), OR(ISPICKVAL(Was_delay_notice_appropriate__c, 'Met'),ISPICKVAL(Was_delay_notice_appropriate__c, 'N/A')), OR(ISPICKVAL(Is_the_outcome_fair__c, 'Met'),ISPICKVAL(Is_the_outcome_fair__c, 'N/A')) ) ), IF( AND( ISPICKVAL(Evaluation_Type__c,'Final Letter Review Assessment'), AND( OR(ISPICKVAL(Did_we_record_all_issues_correctly__c, 'Met'),ISPICKVAL(Did_we_record_all_issues_correctly__c, 'N/A')), OR(ISPICKVAL(Desired_outcome_recorded_correctly__c, 'Met'),ISPICKVAL(Desired_outcome_recorded_correctly__c, 'N/A')), OR(ISPICKVAL(Was_correspondence_well_written__c, 'Met'),ISPICKVAL(Was_correspondence_well_written__c, 'N/A')) ) ), 'Pass', 'Pass With Feedback' ), 'Fail' )
CustomField.label: AssessmentResultFinalLetterReview
